text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thanks for all the hard work at summer training camp this year too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. As we enjoyed
the traditional barbecue party—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey you bastard, step outside right now, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An accomplished racer who conquered the Satsuki Sho
on the Classic Triple Crown route, and whose intense
personality has earned her legions of fans—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship just picked a fight(?)
with me...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
G-Golshi-san...?
Uh, did I do something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't play dumb with me, you bastard!
Everyone knows the giant squid belongs to Golshi-chan, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: G-Giant? Giant squid?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You want takoyaki?! Or squid?! 
Salt or sauce, huh?! Make up your damn mind!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!?
I'm so sorry, I really have no clue...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sorry sorry sorry sorry! So totally sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next to come flying in after that was—
Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A stylish and energetic Umamusume who has achieved numerous great results in Senior Class graded races.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, I mentioned, "Didn't Shion-san say
she was entering the Arima Kinen this year?"
So she's probably—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Huh? No it isn't, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's gotta be it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: As if.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen? ...Ah, that's right!
Both of you are running this year, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's with the "two of you, too"?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, s-sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thaaat's why I'm telling you, quit wearing those sunglasses all the damn time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Enemies can come from the sea, too, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that... Gold Ship handed the yakisoba over to Win Variation and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's huge... and scary...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...'From the sea, too'...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You were giving me advice, weren't ya?
To watch out for the other Umamusume too."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that what this was about?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Come to think of it,
all I was thinking about was beating her!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“That's not good enough, though! Because...
Gold Ship's the kind of person who creates
a buzz every single time she runs a race!”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san works so hard too, which is why she has so many fans...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's the caliber of Umamusume running for this title.
If you want to take center stage—
you have to challenge them with the spirit to beat every single one...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Though I'm not really sure if Golshi actually thought that far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Arima Kinen' is dead serious, but, well...
I guess I'm counting on you, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Please take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, it's pretty scary going up against your generation, though."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm all fired up now!
First, let's dig in to start things off right!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp, chew...!*
Ngh?! D-Delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
this year's summer training camp came to an end.
